github.name: github
github.description: GitHub integration - Git operations and GitHub REST API

actions.name: cloneRepo
actions.description: Clone a repository via the git CLI into a local target directory, using the configured token for auth.

params.name: repoUrl
params.description: HTTPS clone URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo. Owner/repo are parsed from it when not preconfigured.

params.name: targetDir
params.description: Local directory to clone into.

params.name: branch
params.description: Branch to check out after cloning; defaults to the repo's default branch.

actions.name: createBranch
actions.description: Create a new local branch via the git CLI in the configured working directory.

params.name: branchName
params.description: Name of the branch to create.

params.name: baseBranch
params.description: Branch to branch from; defaults to the current branch.

actions.name: commit
actions.description: Commit staged (or given) changes via the git CLI in the configured working directory.

params.name: message
params.description: Commit message.

params.name: files
params.description: Specific files to commit; when omitted, all changes are committed.

actions.name: push
actions.description: Push a local branch to the remote via the git CLI, using the configured token for auth.

params.name: branchName
params.description: Branch name to push.

params.name: force
params.description: Force-push (overwrites remote history); never set true in an agent context.

actions.name: createPR
actions.description: Open a pull request via the GitHub REST API.

params.name: title
params.description: Pull request title.

params.name: body
params.description: Pull request description body.

params.name: baseBranch
params.description: Branch the PR merges into, e.g. main.

params.name: headBranch
params.description: Branch the PR merges from (the feature branch).

params.name: draft
params.description: Open as a draft PR instead of ready-for-review.

actions.name: getPRComments
actions.description: List review comments on a pull request via the GitHub REST API.

params.name: prNumber
params.description: Pull request number.

actions.name: listIssues
actions.description: List issues on the configured repository via the GitHub REST API.

params.name: state
params.description: Issue state filter: 'open', 'closed', or 'all'; defaults to open.

params.name: labels
params.description: Only issues carrying all of these labels.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Page size for the GitHub API request.

actions.name: getIssue
actions.description: Fetch a single issue's details via the GitHub REST API.

params.name: issueNumber
params.description: Issue number.

actions.name: getFile
actions.description: Read a file's content from a repository at a given ref (declared intent — dispatch is being wired).

params.name: owner
params.description: Repository owner (user or org).

params.name: repo
params.description: Repository name.

params.name: path
params.description: File path within the repository.

params.name: ref
params.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to read from; defaults to the default branch.

actions.name: listCommits
actions.description: List commits on a repository, optionally filtered by file path (declared intent — dispatch is being wired).

params.name: owner
params.description: Repository owner (user or org).

params.name: repo
params.description: Repository name.

params.name: path
params.description: Only commits touching this file path.

params.name: ref
params.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to start from; defaults to the default branch.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Page size for the GitHub API request.

actions.name: createIssue
actions.description: Open a new issue on a repository (declared intent — dispatch is being wired).

params.name: owner
params.description: Repository owner (user or org).

params.name: repo
params.description: Repository name.

params.name: title
params.description: Issue title.

params.name: body
params.description: Issue body/description.

params.name: labels
params.description: Labels to apply to the new issue.

stripe.name: stripe
stripe.description: Stripe payment processing - create intents, confirm payments, refunds

actions.name: createPaymentIntent
actions.description: Create a Stripe PaymentIntent for a one-off charge.

params.name: amount
params.description: Charge amount in the currency's smallest unit (e.g. cents for USD).

params.name: currency
params.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. usd.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Arbitrary key-value tags attached to the PaymentIntent (string values only).

actions.name: confirmPayment
actions.description: Confirm a previously created PaymentIntent, attempting to complete the charge.

params.name: paymentIntentId
params.description: The PaymentIntent id returned by createPaymentIntent.

actions.name: refund
actions.description: Refund a charged PaymentIntent, in full or in part.

params.name: paymentIntentId
params.description: The PaymentIntent id to refund.

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount to refund in the currency's smallest unit; omit for a full refund.

llm.name: llm
llm.description: LLM service for content generation, classification, and structured extraction

actions.name: generate
actions.description: Generate free-form text from a prompt via the configured LLM provider (default 'You are a helpful assistant.' system prompt).

params.name: userPrompt
params.description: The user/task prompt sent to the model.

params.name: systemPrompt
params.description: System prompt steering the model's behavior; defaults to a generic assistant prompt.

params.name: model
params.description: Model id override; when set, a fresh client is built for this call instead of the shared one.

params.name: temperature
params.description: Sampling temperature (0-1ish, provider-dependent); higher is more random.

params.name: maxTokens
params.description: Maximum tokens to generate; defaults to 1024.

actions.name: classify
actions.description: Classify text into exactly one of a caller-supplied category list, with a confidence score and reasoning.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to classify.

params.name: categories
params.description: Closed set of category labels the model must choose from.

params.name: model
params.description: Model id override.

actions.name: extract
actions.description: Extract structured data from text according to a JSON-schema-shaped description; returned data is not validated against the schema.

params.name: text
params.description: Source text to extract data from.

params.name: schema
params.description: JSON-schema-like description of the fields to extract; passed to the model as a prompt, not enforced structurally.

params.name: model
params.description: Model id override.

actions.name: summarize
actions.description: Summarize text, optionally constrained by length and style, returning a summary plus key points.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to summarize.

params.name: maxLength
params.description: Target maximum summary length in words.

params.name: style
params.description: Summary style: 'bullet' for bullet points, 'detailed' for thorough, otherwise concise.

params.name: model
params.description: Model id override.

actions.name: embed
actions.description: Generate embedding vectors for an array of texts via the configured embedding model (default baai/bge-base-en-v1.5 on OpenRouter, independent of the chat provider).

params.name: texts
params.description: Texts to embed, one vector per entry, in order.

params.name: model
params.description: Embedding model id override.

ml.name: ml
ml.description: ML service - model inference on a trained or off-the-shelf checkpoint, reached via a deployed serving orbital

actions.name: infer
actions.description: Run inference against a deployed model-serving orbital by posting an INFER event and reading the prediction back out of the emitted INFERRED result; may cold-start (up to 60s default timeout).

params.name: model
params.description: Checkpoint or model identifier the serving orbital resolves.

params.name: input
params.description: JSON-safe model input payload.

youtube.name: youtube
youtube.description: YouTube Data API - search videos, get video/channel details

actions.name: search
actions.description: Search YouTube via the Data API and return matching video snippets.

params.name: query
params.description: Search query text.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum number of results; defaults to 10.

params.name: type
params.description: Resource type filter passed to the Data API (e.g. 'video', 'channel', 'playlist').

actions.name: getVideo
actions.description: Fetch a video's snippet and statistics via the YouTube Data API.

params.name: videoId
params.description: YouTube video id.

actions.name: getChannel
actions.description: Fetch a channel's snippet and statistics via the YouTube Data API.

params.name: channelId
params.description: YouTube channel id.

twilio.name: twilio
twilio.description: Twilio messaging - send SMS, WhatsApp messages

actions.name: sendSMS
actions.description: Send an SMS message via Twilio.

params.name: to
params.description: Destination phone number, E.164 format.

params.name: body
params.description: Message text.

params.name: from
params.description: Sender phone number; defaults to TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER.

actions.name: sendWhatsApp
actions.description: Send a WhatsApp message via Twilio, using the configured phone number as sender on both ends.

params.name: to
params.description: Destination phone number, E.164 format (sent as whatsapp:number).

params.name: body
params.description: Message text.

actions.name: send
actions.description: Send a transactional email via the configured provider (SendGrid or Resend).

params.name: to
params.description: Recipient email address.

params.name: subject
params.description: Email subject line.

params.name: body
params.description: Plain-text (or HTML, if `htmlBody` is absent) body content.

params.name: from
params.description: Sender address; defaults to FROM_EMAIL.

params.name: htmlBody
params.description: HTML content; when present `body` becomes the plain-text alternative.

params.name: replyTo
params.description: Reply-To address.

params.name: templateId
params.description: Provider template reference (SendGrid dynamic templates; Resend rejects it loudly).

webhook.name: webhook
webhook.description: Outbound webhook - signed HTTP POST notifications to external endpoints

actions.name: send
actions.description: POST a JSON event notification to an external URL, HMAC-SHA256-signed when a secret is configured; 5xx responses retry, 4xx do not.

params.name: url
params.description: Destination URL to POST to.

params.name: event
params.description: Event name, carried in the body and the X-Almadar-Event header.

params.name: payload
params.description: Event payload; defaults to an empty object.

params.name: secret
params.description: Per-call HMAC signing secret, overriding WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET.

push.name: push
push.description: Web Push - VAPID-signed browser push notifications

actions.name: send
actions.description: Send a VAPID-signed Web Push notification to a browser PushSubscription endpoint.

params.name: subscription
params.description: Browser PushSubscription: endpoint URL plus the p256dh/auth encryption keys.

params.name: title
params.description: Notification title.

params.name: body
params.description: Notification body text.

params.name: url
params.description: URL to open when the notification is clicked.

params.name: icon
params.description: Notification icon URL.

calendar.name: calendar
calendar.description: Google Calendar - events, free-busy, watch channels (service account / domain-wide delegation)

actions.name: listEvents
actions.description: List events on a Google Calendar; pass `syncToken` for incremental sync instead of a time window (the API rejects combining them).

params.name: calendarId
params.description: Calendar id; defaults to GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID (or 'primary').

params.name: timeMin
params.description: ISO start of the time window (ignored when `syncToken` is set).

params.name: timeMax
params.description: ISO end of the time window (ignored when `syncToken` is set).

params.name: syncToken
params.description: Incremental-sync token from a previous call's `nextSyncToken`; supersedes timeMin/timeMax.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum events to return; defaults to 250.

actions.name: createEvent
actions.description: Create a calendar event; an all-day event uses a 10-char (YYYY-MM-DD) start with no `end`/`durationMinutes`, defaulting to the next day.

params.name: calendarId
params.description: Calendar id; defaults to GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID.

params.name: summary
params.description: Event title.

params.name: description
params.description: Event description.

params.name: location
params.description: Event location text.

params.name: start
params.description: ISO start (10 chars = all-day date, longer = dateTime).

params.name: end
params.description: ISO end; if omitted, derived from `durationMinutes` or the all-day next-day convention.

params.name: durationMinutes
params.description: Duration in minutes used to derive `end` when `end` is omitted (non-all-day events only).

actions.name: updateEvent
actions.description: Patch an existing event's fields; only fields present in params are changed.

params.name: calendarId
params.description: Calendar id; defaults to GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID.

params.name: eventId
params.description: Id of the event to update.

params.name: summary
params.description: New event title.

params.name: description
params.description: New event description.

params.name: location
params.description: New event location text.

params.name: start
params.description: New ISO start.

params.name: end
params.description: New ISO end.

actions.name: deleteEvent
actions.description: Delete a calendar event.

params.name: calendarId
params.description: Calendar id; defaults to GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID.

params.name: eventId
params.description: Id of the event to delete.

actions.name: freeBusy
actions.description: Query busy time blocks on a calendar within a window.

params.name: calendarId
params.description: Calendar id; defaults to GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID.

params.name: timeMin
params.description: ISO start of the query window.

params.name: timeMax
params.description: ISO end of the query window.

actions.name: watch
actions.description: Register a push-notification channel for calendar change events (Google Calendar API watch).

params.name: calendarId
params.description: Calendar id; defaults to GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID.

params.name: channelId
params.description: Caller-chosen id identifying this notification channel.

params.name: address
params.description: HTTPS callback URL Google POSTs change notifications to.

params.name: ttlSeconds
params.description: Requested channel time-to-live in seconds.

actions.name: stopWatch
actions.description: Stop an active watch channel, ending calendar change notifications.

params.name: channelId
params.description: The channel id from the corresponding `watch` call.

params.name: resourceId
params.description: The resourceId returned by the corresponding `watch` call.

drive.name: drive
drive.description: Google Drive - files, folders, sharing (service account / domain-wide delegation)

actions.name: listFiles
actions.description: List non-trashed files in a Google Drive folder, optionally filtered by a Drive API query clause.

params.name: folderId
params.description: Restrict to files whose parents include this folder id.

params.name: query
params.description: Extra Drive API query clause, ANDed with the folder/trashed filters.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum files to return; defaults to 100.

actions.name: getFile
actions.description: Download a file's content, base64-encoded.

params.name: fileId
params.description: Drive file id.

actions.name: uploadFile
actions.description: Upload a file to Drive; writes go through the user OAuth client when configured (service-account uploads have no storage quota on personal accounts).

params.name: name
params.description: File name to create.

params.name: content
params.description: File content as a base64 data URL (data:mime;base64,...) or raw base64/plain text.

params.name: mimeType
params.description: MIME type; inferred from a data URL when omitted.

params.name: folderId
params.description: Parent folder id; defaults to GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID.

actions.name: createFolder
actions.description: Create a new Drive folder.

params.name: name
params.description: Folder name to create.

params.name: parentId
params.description: Parent folder id; defaults to GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID.

actions.name: shareFile
actions.description: Grant a user permission on a Drive file.

params.name: fileId
params.description: Drive file id.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the grantee.

params.name: role
params.description: Permission level; defaults to 'reader'.

metaAds.name: metaAds
metaAds.description: Meta Ads - read-only Marketing Insights (spend, campaigns)

actions.name: getSpend
actions.description: Fetch total ad spend, impressions, and clicks for an account over a date range via the Meta Graph API Marketing Insights endpoint (read-only).

params.name: accountId
params.description: Ad account id (with or without the `act_` prefix); defaults to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID.

params.name: since
params.description: Range start date (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: until
params.description: Range end date (YYYY-MM-DD).

actions.name: listCampaigns
actions.description: List campaigns on an ad account via the Meta Graph API (read-only); dailyBudget is converted from Meta's minor-unit reporting.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Ad account id (with or without the `act_` prefix); defaults to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by campaign effective_status (e.g. 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED').

accounting.name: accounting
accounting.description: Accounting export - invoice/journal rows to import-ready CSV

actions.name: exportInvoices
actions.description: Shape invoice rows into an import-ready CSV export (no accounting-vendor connection — generic column set).

params.name: invoices
params.description: Invoice rows to export, in column order id/number/customer/issuedAt/dueAt/currency/net/tax/gross/status.

params.name: format
params.description: Export format; only 'csv' is currently supported.

actions.name: exportJournal
actions.description: Shape journal entry rows into an import-ready CSV export.

params.name: entries
params.description: Journal entry rows to export, in column order date/account/description/debit/credit/reference.

params.name: format
params.description: Export format; only 'csv' is currently supported.

banking.name: banking
banking.description: Banking - GoCardless Bank Account Data (requisitions, accounts, transactions)

actions.name: createRequisition
actions.description: Start a GoCardless Bank Account Data requisition (bank-connection consent flow); the returned `link` is where the end user authorizes access.

params.name: institutionId
params.description: GoCardless institution id (the bank to connect).

params.name: redirectUrl
params.description: URL GoCardless redirects the user to after consent.

params.name: reference
params.description: Caller-chosen reference to correlate the requisition.

actions.name: listAccounts
actions.description: List account ids linked under a completed requisition.

params.name: requisitionId
params.description: Requisition id from createRequisition.

actions.name: listTransactions
actions.description: List booked transactions on a linked bank account, optionally filtered by date range.

params.name: accountId
params.description: GoCardless account id.

params.name: dateFrom
params.description: Only transactions booked on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: dateTo
params.description: Only transactions booked on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

actions.name: sendEnvelope
actions.description: Send a document for e-signature via DocuSign; accepts the document content as a data URL or raw base64.

params.name: recipientEmail
params.description: Signer's email address.

params.name: recipientName
params.description: Signer's display name.

params.name: documentName
params.description: Document file name (its extension also picks the DocuSign fileExtension).

params.name: documentContent
params.description: Document content as a base64 data URL or raw base64.

params.name: emailSubject
params.description: Envelope email subject; defaults to "Please sign: " + documentName.

actions.name: getEnvelopeStatus
actions.description: Poll a DocuSign envelope's signing status.

params.name: envelopeId
params.description: DocuSign envelope id from sendEnvelope.

actions.name: downloadDocument
actions.description: Download the combined signed document(s) for a completed envelope, base64-encoded PDF.

params.name: envelopeId
params.description: DocuSign envelope id.

actions.name: build
actions.description: Simulate building a container image (in-memory backend — no real Docker daemon/SDK; a real build is not yet implemented).

params.name: tag
params.description: Image tag to build, e.g. myapp:latest.

params.name: dockerfile
params.description: Dockerfile path; defaults to 'Dockerfile'.

params.name: context
params.description: Build context directory; defaults to '.'.

params.name: buildArgs
params.description: Build-time --build-arg values.

actions.name: run
actions.description: Simulate starting a container from an image (in-memory backend).

params.name: image
params.description: Image to run (as built/tagged by the `build` action, or an arbitrary name).

params.name: name
params.description: Container name; auto-generated when omitted.

params.name: ports
params.description: Host/container port mappings.

params.name: env
params.description: Environment variables set inside the container.

params.name: volumes
params.description: Host/container path mounts.

params.name: command
params.description: Override command run inside the container.

actions.name: stop
actions.description: Stop a running (or paused) simulated container.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id, or a unique id prefix.

actions.name: remove
actions.description: Remove a simulated container; fails if it is running unless `force` is set.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id, or a unique id prefix.

params.name: force
params.description: Remove even if the container is currently running.

actions.name: logs
actions.description: Fetch generated log lines for a simulated container.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id, or a unique id prefix.

params.name: tail
params.description: Number of most-recent lines to return; defaults to 100.

params.name: since
params.description: Only lines timestamped at/after this ISO time.

actions.name: status
actions.description: Fetch a simulated container's current status and metadata.

params.name: containerId
params.description: Container id, or a unique id prefix.

actions.name: list
actions.description: List simulated containers; by default only running ones (like `docker ps`).

params.name: all
params.description: Include stopped/exited containers, not just running ones.

params.name: filterByLabel
params.description: Filter by a `key` or `key=value` label match.

storage.name: storage
storage.description: Object storage — upload, download, delete, list files

actions.name: upload
actions.description: Upload an object to an S3-compatible bucket (real S3/R2/MinIO backend when storage credentials are configured, in-memory dev fallback otherwise — refused in production). Admits either the canonical `key`+`content` pair or the file-form `file` payload (UploadDropZone's `{ name, size, type, content }` shape); when `file` is present its `key`/`content` are derived from it.

params.name: bucket
params.description: Target bucket; defaults to STORAGE_BUCKET.

params.name: key
params.description: Object key to store under (canonical shape); ignored when `file` is present.

params.name: content
params.description: Object content as a base64 data URL, raw base64, or plain text (canonical shape); ignored when `file` is present.

params.name: contentType
params.description: MIME type override for the canonical shape; inferred from a data URL when omitted.

params.name: file
params.description: File-form upload payload (as emitted by UploadDropZone); `content` is a base64 data URL.

params.name: acl
params.description: Object ACL — 'public' produces a public URL, otherwise the URL is signed/private.

params.name: maxSize
params.description: Reject the upload if the file-form payload's declared size exceeds this many bytes.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Arbitrary metadata stored alongside the object (in-memory backend only).

actions.name: uploadMany
actions.description: Upload a whole UploadDropZone batch in one call, one item per file — the FSM-friendly shape for bulk-persisting uploaded-file rows.

params.name: bucket
params.description: Target bucket; defaults to STORAGE_BUCKET.

params.name: files
params.description: Files to upload, in UploadDropZone's `{ name, size, type, content }` shape.

params.name: acl
params.description: Object ACL applied to every file in the batch.

params.name: maxSize
params.description: Reject any file whose declared size exceeds this many bytes.

actions.name: download
actions.description: Download an object's content, base64-encoded.

params.name: bucket
params.description: Bucket the object lives in; defaults to STORAGE_BUCKET.

params.name: key
params.description: Object key.

actions.name: list
actions.description: List object keys in a bucket, optionally prefix-filtered, one page at a time.

params.name: bucket
params.description: Bucket to list; defaults to STORAGE_BUCKET.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Only keys starting with this prefix.

params.name: maxKeys
params.description: Maximum keys per page; defaults to 1000.

params.name: continuationToken
params.description: Pagination token from a previous call's `nextToken`.

actions.name: delete
actions.description: Delete an object from a bucket.

params.name: bucket
params.description: Bucket the object lives in; defaults to STORAGE_BUCKET.

params.name: key
params.description: Object key to delete.

actions.name: getSignedUrl
actions.description: Generate a time-limited pre-signed URL for direct GET or PUT access to an object.

params.name: bucket
params.description: Bucket the object lives in; defaults to STORAGE_BUCKET.

params.name: key
params.description: Object key.

params.name: expiresIn
params.description: URL validity window in seconds; defaults to 3600.

params.name: operation
params.description: Whether the URL authorizes a read or a write; defaults to 'get'.

queue.name: queue
queue.description: Message queue — publish, subscribe, acknowledge messages

actions.name: enqueue
actions.description: Add a job to an in-memory job queue, ordered by priority (higher first) among ready jobs.

params.name: queue
params.description: Queue name.

params.name: payload
params.description: Arbitrary job payload.

params.name: delay
params.description: Delay before the job becomes eligible for dequeue, in milliseconds.

params.name: priority
params.description: Priority — higher values are dequeued before lower ones.

actions.name: dequeue
actions.description: Pop the highest-priority pending job whose delay has elapsed, marking it 'processing'; returns null if none is ready.

params.name: queue
params.description: Queue name.

actions.name: status
actions.description: Look up a job's current status by id.

params.name: jobId
params.description: Job id from enqueue.

actions.name: complete
actions.description: Mark a 'processing' job completed and store its result; no-op (returns false) if the job isn't in 'processing' state.

params.name: jobId
params.description: Job id.

params.name: result
params.description: Result payload to attach to the job.

actions.name: fail
actions.description: Mark a 'processing' job failed; no-op (returns false) if the job isn't in 'processing' state.

params.name: jobId
params.description: Job id.

params.name: error
params.description: Failure reason to attach to the job.

actions.name: cancel
actions.description: Remove a 'pending' job from its queue; no-op (returns false) once it has been dequeued.

params.name: jobId
params.description: Job id.

actions.name: size
actions.description: Count pending and processing jobs in a queue.

params.name: queue
params.description: Queue name.

actions.name: get
actions.description: Read a key's value from the in-memory cache; returns null (as `value`) if absent or expired.

params.name: key
params.description: Cache key.

actions.name: set
actions.description: Write a key's value, optionally with an expiry.

params.name: key
params.description: Cache key.

params.name: value
params.description: Value to store.

params.name: ttl
params.description: Time-to-live in seconds; omit for no expiry.

actions.name: delete
actions.description: Delete a key.

params.name: key
params.description: Cache key.

actions.name: lock
actions.description: Acquire a mutex on a key; fails (returns acquired:false) if another lock on the key is still alive.

params.name: key
params.description: Lock key.

params.name: ttl
params.description: Lock time-to-live in milliseconds; defaults to 30000 (30s).

actions.name: unlock
actions.description: Release a lock; only succeeds when `lockId` matches the current holder.

params.name: key
params.description: Lock key.

params.name: lockId
params.description: Lock id returned by the corresponding `lock` call.

actions.name: increment
actions.description: Atomically add to a numeric key's value (creating it at 0 if absent), preserving any existing TTL.

params.name: key
params.description: Cache key.

params.name: by
